contentItem.title: 等量关系：平行六面体与平行线与比例
contentItem.englishTitle: If three straight lines be proportional, the parallelepipedal solid formed out of the three is equal to the parallelepipedal solid on the mean which is equilateral, but equiangular with the aforesaid solid.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: If three straight lines be proportional, the parallelepipedal solid formed out of the three is equal to the parallelepipedal solid on the mean which is equilateral, but equiangular with the aforesaid solid.
如果三条直线为成比例, 由三条平行管道形成的固体等于以等量线为平均值的平行管道固体, 但与上述固体的角形相等。

Let A, B, C be three straight lines in proportion, so that, as A is to B, so is B to C; I say that the solid formed out of A, B, C is equal to the solid on B which is equilateral, but equiangular with the aforesaid solid.
让A,B,C成三条直线,A比B等于B比C;我说,A、B和C的固体构成等于B的固体,该固体是等边的,但与上述固体呈正对角；A 与 B 之比等于 B 与 C 之比。

Let there be set out the solid angle at E contained by the angles DEG, GEF, FED, let each of the straight lines DE, GE, EF be made equal to B, and let the parallelepipedal solid EK be completed, let LM be made equal to A, and on the straight line LM, and at the point L on it, let there be constructed a solid angle equal to the solid angle at E, namely that contained by NLO, OLM, MLN; let LO be made equal to B, and LN equal to C.
将E的固体角设为DEG,GEF,FED,使每一直线的长度等于B,GE,EF,使平行管道固体EK完成,使LM等于A,在LM线上,在L点,在E点,即NLO,OLM,MLN组成的固线角,建造一个等于固线角的固体角;使LO等于B,LN等于C。
Now, since, as A is to B, so is B to C, while A is equal to LM, B to each of the straight lines LO, ED, and C to LN, therefore, as LM is to EF, so is DE to LN.
现在,A对B的比等于C,A等于LM,B等于每条直线LO、ED和C对LN,LM对EF等于DE对LN；A 与 B 之比等于 B 与 C 之比；LM 与 EF 之比等于 DE 与 LN 之比。
Thus the sides about the equal angles NLM, DEF are reciprocally proportional; therefore the parallelogram MN is equal to the parallelogram DF. [[VI. 14](/principles/euclid-6-14)]
因此,对等角度NLM,DEF是成比例;因此,平行四边形,MN等于平行四边形,DF。 [[VI. 14](/principles/euclid-6-14)]

And, since the angles DEF, NLM are two plane rectilineal angles, and on them the elevated straight lines LO, EG are set up which are equal to one another and contain equal angles with the original straight lines respectively, therefore the perpendiculars drawn from the points G, O to the planes through NL, LM and DE, EF are equal to one another; [[XI. 35](/principles/euclid-11-35), Por.] hence the solids LH, EK are of the same height.
由于角度DEF,NLM是两个直线直线角度,而上面的直线则分别为平面,LO,EG,分别是等同的,分别包含与原始直线相同的角度,因此从G、O至平面至NL、LM和DE,EF点的垂直线是等同的;]因此,固体LH、EK是同高的。 [ [XI. 35](/principles/euclid-11-35)
But parallelepipedal solids on equal bases and of the same height are equal to one another; [[XI. 31](/principles/euclid-11-31)] therefore the solid HL is equal to the solid EK.
但底边和同一高度的平行管道固体是等量的;因此,HL固体等于EK固体。 [[XI. 31](/principles/euclid-11-31)]

And LH is the solid formed out of A, B, C, and EK the solid on B; therefore the parallelepipedal solid formed out of A, B, C is equal to the solid on B which is equilateral, but equiangular with the aforesaid solid. Q. E. D.
LH是A,B,C和EK的固体组成的固体;因此,A,B,C的平行管道固体相当于B的固体,该固体是等量的,但与上述固体的角相等。
